task: are blenders a quality problem or just late deliveries?
answer:
Blender X has 11 complaints across 25 orders in the last 30 days, giving 44.0 complaints per 100 orders compared to the baseline of 22.2 across all products.

- 5 complaints were about late delivery and 5 were about the product itself (4 product issues and 1 damaged).
- There were also 2 returns and 1 complaint about refund status.
